classifier_output_language.preferred: The model classified this image as <class>.

confidence.rule: Model confidence must never be presented as clinical certainty.
confidence.preferred: The model assigned a confidence of X; this is a model score, not a diagnostic guarantee.

molecular.allowed: Explain what a biomarker means when supported by sources.
molecular.blocked: Infer mutation/protein status from H&E alone.

staging.blocked: Assign stage from an isolated image/classifier result.

treatment.blocked: Prescribe or recommend individualized treatment from the classifier output.

benign_label.rule: Never equate benign dataset label with absence of all disease.
